jobs.title: Consolidation Specialist
jobs.description:
The Consolidation team is deliberately small. There is no layer between you and the output: you will own workstreams end to end, report directly to the Head of Consolidation, and see your work land in the numbers the Group publishes.

It also puts you at the centre of the finance organisation. Consolidation sits at the point where every local finance team, the Group functions and the external auditors converge, so you will build a view of how the whole business works that few other roles offer. If you want technical IFRS work with visibility, this is the seat.

## The job in brief:

- Consolidation specialist
- Working model : Hybrid from Chiasso or full-remote from Romania
- Team: Consolidation team within the Finance department.
- . You will also support the team on work that serves other departments across the Group. ## What You Will Need to Solve: Prepare, maintain and execute the reconciliation of consolidated ledger accounts and financial statements: monthly consolidated balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow and equity statements, capital expenditure schedules, intercompany schedules and related deliverables
- Preparation and execution of consolidation adjustments and intercompany calculations according to the Group’s Transfer Pricing policies
- Reconciliation of the Group Net Financial Position on a monthly basis and accounting of key personnel long-term incentive plans
- Run periodical reviews of the reporting packages prepared by local finance managers in Tagetik
- Support the preparation of the Impairment Test (IAS 36) and of interim and annual disclosures
- Support the preparation of forecast figures and financial modelling on request both at Group and local level.

## Systems, process and control:

- Develop, test, deploy and maintain consolidated reports in Tagetik
- Design and maintain internal controls over financial reporting processes, ensuring control activities in your area of responsibility are fully executed, documented, and formalised
- Build and maintain documented procedures that keep systems, processes and controls running efficiently and financial reporting accurate, including reporting guidelines for Group subsidiaries and maintaining of the Group Chart of Accounts
- Support the implementation and set-up of consolidation procedures and the intercompany set-up

## Working with others

- Manage the relationship with external auditors and consultants on ordinary requests under the supervision of the Head of Consolidation
- Act as a reference point for local finance teams and other Group functions on consolidation and reporting matters

## Requisiti e competenze

## Your expertise:

- Master’s degree in accounting or finance
- At least three years in technical accounting and financial reporting, with deep knowledge of IFRS, gained in a large multinational group or in an audit or consultancy firm
- Deep knowledge of consolidation rules and techniques
- Professional-level English, written and spoken
- Practical fluency in AI tools like Claude, standing alongside IFRS expertise. Candidates must already use AI to speed up real-world reporting and analysis while possessing the critical judgment required to know when to trust AI outputs and when to double-check them for accuracy
- Advanced Microsoft Excel: lookups, pivot tables and confidence working with large volumes of data. Solid working knowledge of Google Workspace, in particular G-Sheets

## Desirable:

- Audit experience gained in a Big 4 firm
- Working knowledge of Tagetik, or of a comparable consolidation and reporting system

## Cosa offriamo

Perks of working with us:

## How we work together:

- An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities)

- Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays

- Flexible start and end of the working day

- Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations

## How we learn together:

- Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time.

- Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content

## Other perks: - 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes - Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues - Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares - We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Wish you were here? We do, too! Selection process steps*:

- HR interview

- 1st interview (Manager): soft skills + technical knowledge

- Final meeting in person (Chiasso)

- Offer extended

(*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview)

## Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

Eligibility criteria:

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.

## Chi è lastminute.com

At lastminute.com, we live for the holidays. We are the European Travel-Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il team di consolidamento è volutamente piccolo. Non c'è livello tra voi e l'output: si posseggono flussi di lavoro finiscono per finire, si riferiscono direttamente al Capo del Consolidamento, e vedere il vostro terreno di lavoro nei numeri che il Gruppo pubblica.

Ti mette anche al centro dell'organizzazione finanziaria. Consolidamento si trova al punto in cui ogni squadra finanziaria locale, le funzioni del Gruppo e i revisori esterni convergono, così si costruisce una visione di come l'intero business funziona che pochi altri ruoli offrono. Se vuoi che gli IFRS tecnici lavorino con visibilità, questo è il sedile.

## Il lavoro in breve:

- Specialista del consolidamento
- Modello di lavoro: Hybrid from Chiasso o full-remote from Romania
- Team: team di consolidamento all'interno del reparto Finanza.
- . Supporterete anche il team sul lavoro che serve altri dipartimenti del Gruppo. ## What You Will Need to Solve: Preparare, mantenere ed eseguire la riconciliazione dei conti consolidati e dei rendiconti finanziari: bilancio consolidato mensile, profitto e perdita, cash flow e bilanci azionari, liste delle spese di capitale, programmi intercompany e relativi consegnabili
- Preparazione ed esecuzione di aggiustamenti di consolidamento e calcoli intercompany secondo le politiche del Gruppo Transfer Pricing
- Riconciliazione della Posizione Finanziaria Netta del Gruppo su base mensile e contabilità dei principali piani di incentivazione a lungo termine del personale
- Eseguire revisioni periodiche dei pacchetti di report preparati dai gestori finanziari locali in Tagetik
- Sostenere la preparazione del Test di Impairment (IAS 36) e delle informative intermedie e annuali
- Sostenere la preparazione dei dati di previsione e la modellazione finanziaria su richiesta sia a livello di Gruppo che locale.

## Sistemi, processo e controllo:

- Sviluppare, testare, distribuire e mantenere rapporti consolidati in Tagetik
- Progettare e mantenere i controlli interni sui processi di reporting finanziario, assicurando che le attività di controllo nel vostro settore di responsabilità siano completamente eseguite, documentate e formalizzate
- Costruire e mantenere procedure documentate che mantengono accurati sistemi, processi e controlli in esecuzione efficiente e reportistica finanziaria, comprese le linee guida per le società controllate del Gruppo e il mantenimento della Carta dei conti del Gruppo
- Sostenere l'attuazione e l'attuazione delle procedure di consolidamento e l'organizzazione intercompany

## Lavorare con altri

- Gestire il rapporto con revisori esterni e consulenti su richieste ordinarie sotto la supervisione del Capo di consolidamento
- Atto come punto di riferimento per le squadre di finanza locale e altre funzioni del Gruppo in materia di consolidamento e reporting

## Requisiti e competenze

## La tua esperienza:

- Laurea magistrale in contabilità o finanza
- Almeno tre anni di contabilità tecnica e di rendicontazione finanziaria, con profonda conoscenza degli IFRS, acquisiti in un grande gruppo multinazionale o in una società di revisione o consulenza
- Conoscenza profonda delle regole e delle tecniche di consolidamento
- Inglese di livello professionale, scritto e parlato
- Fluency pratico in strumenti di intelligenza artificiale come Claude, accanto alle competenze di IFRS. I candidati devono già utilizzare l'IA per accelerare la segnalazione e l'analisi del mondo reale, pur possedendo il giudizio critico necessario per sapere quando fidarsi delle uscite dell'IA e quando controllarle per precisione
- Avanzato Microsoft Excel: ricerche, tabelle pivot e fiducia che lavorano con grandi volumi di dati. Conoscenza solida del lavoro di Google Workspace, in particolare G-Sheets

## Desirable:

- Audit esperienza acquisita in un'azienda Big 4
- Conoscenze di lavoro di Tagetik, o di un sistema di consolidamento e reporting comparabile

## Cosa?

I vantaggi di lavorare con noi:

## Come lavoriamo insieme:

- Un ambiente inclusivo, amichevole e internazionale (si lavorerà con colleghi di +10 paesi e oltre 48 nazionalità)

- Settimana lavorativa più breve (36h a tempo pieno), con una mezza giornata di lavoro il venerdì

- Inizio flessibile e fine della giornata lavorativa

- Possibilità di lavorare da qualsiasi luogo per un periodo di tempo all'anno definito secondo le normative locali

## Come impariamo insieme:

- Fri-Yays: mezza giornata di venerdì mattina con un mandato no-meeting e dedicato al lavoro profondo, alla crescita personale, all'apprendimento e alla formazione e/o al tempo di messa a fuoco.

- Corsi di formazione professionali e manageriali, accesso a piattaforme e-learning come O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (a seconda del dipartimento), e alla nostra piattaforma interna che offre contenuti di formazione su misura

## Altri vantaggi: - 2 giorni di ferie pagate all'anno per scopi di volontariato - Occasionali eventi sociali per favorire i collegamenti tra colleghi - Riduzioni di settore di viaggio e tariffe di personale esclusivo flash - Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti attraverso i momenti significativi della vita con opzioni di congedo (ad esempio responsabilità genitoriali, matrimoni, lutti, trasferizioni, ecc.) in linea con le leggi locali. Vorrei che fossi qui? Anche noi! Procedura di selezione*:

- Intervista HR

- 1a intervista (Manager): soft skills + conoscenze tecniche

- Incontro finale di persona (Chiasso)

- Offerta prolungata

(*Si prega di notare che il processo può leggermente variare. Il responsabile del reclutatore condividerà ulteriori dettagli durante l'installazione dell'intervista)

## Il nostro impegno per celebrare la diversità e generare appartenenza

Al centro della nostra cultura è un impegno per l'inclusione tra razza, genere, età, orientamento sessuale, religione, identità di genere o espressione, e l'accessibilità. Crediamo fortemente in uno spazio pari opportunità, che è accogliente e celebra l'unicità di tutti coloro che lavorano qui. Apprezziamo diverse esperienze vissute e punti di vista di rispetto, come sappiamo l'unicità guida l'innovazione. Vogliamo assicurarci che la nostra gente rifletta le comunità di tutto il mondo che aiutiamo a viaggiare.

Criteri di ammissibilità:

Inviando le tue informazioni e la tua domanda, confermi che sei legalmente autorizzato a lavorare nel paese di lavoro e che non hai bisogno di sponsorizzazione del visto per ottenere lo stato del visto di lavoro.

## Chi è lastminute.com

A lastminute.com, viviamo per le vacanze. Siamo il leader europeo Travel-Tech nei pacchetti di vacanza dinamica. Con la tecnologia, trasformiamo pensieri spontanei in esperienze significative, aiutando le persone a viaggiare nel mondo
descriptionByLocale.de:
Das Consolidation-Team ist bewusst klein. Es gibt keine Ebene zwischen Ihnen und dem Output: Sie werden Workstreams Ende an Ende besitzen, direkt an den Head of Consolidation berichten und Ihr Arbeitsland in den von der Gruppe veröffentlichten Zahlen sehen.

Es stellt Sie auch in den Mittelpunkt der Finanzorganisation. Die Konsolidierung befindet sich an dem Punkt, an dem sich jedes lokale Finanzteam, die Funktionen der Gruppe und die externen Auditoren annähern, sodass Sie einen Überblick darüber erhalten, wie das gesamte Unternehmen funktioniert, den nur wenige andere Rollen bieten. Wenn Sie technische IFRS mit Sichtbarkeit arbeiten wollen, ist dies der Sitz.

## Der Job in Kürze:

- Konsolidierungsspezialist
- Arbeitsmodell : Hybrid von Chiasso oder vollständig entfernt von Rumänien
- Team: Konsolidierungsteam innerhalb der Finanzabteilung.
- Sie werden das Team auch bei der Arbeit unterstützen, die andere Abteilungen in der gesamten Gruppe betreut. ## Was Sie lösen müssen: Bereiten, pflegen und führen Sie den Abgleich von konsolidierten Hauptbuchkonten und Jahresabschlüssen vor: monatliche konsolidierte Bilanz, Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen, Cashflow- und Eigenkapitalrechnungen, Investitionspläne, konzerninterne Pläne und damit verbundene Leistungen
- Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Konsolidierungsanpassungen und unternehmensübergreifenden Berechnungen gemäß den Verrechnungspreisrichtlinien des Konzerns
- Abgleich der Nettofinanzposition der Gruppe auf monatlicher Basis und Bilanzierung der langfristigen Incentive-Pläne für Personal in Schlüsselpositionen
- Führen Sie regelmäßige Überprüfungen der von lokalen Finanzmanagern in Tagetik erstellten Berichtspakete durch
- Unterstützung der Vorbereitung des Impairment-Tests (IAS 36) und der vorläufigen und jährlichen Offenlegungen
- Unterstützung der Erstellung von Prognosezahlen und Finanzmodellen auf Wunsch sowohl auf Konzern- als auch auf lokaler Ebene.

## Systeme, Verfahren und Steuerung:

- Entwicklung, Test, Bereitstellung und Pflege konsolidierter Berichte in Tagetik
- Konzipieren und pflegen Sie interne Kontrollen über Finanzberichterstattungsprozesse, um sicherzustellen, dass die Kontrollaktivitäten in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich vollständig durchgeführt, dokumentiert und formalisiert werden
- Aufbau und Pflege von dokumentierten Verfahren, die den effizienten Ablauf von Systemen, Prozessen und Kontrollen sowie die Genauigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung gewährleisten, einschließlich der Berichtsrichtlinien für Tochtergesellschaften der Gruppe und der Führung des Konzernabschlussplans
- Unterstützung der Umsetzung und Einrichtung von Konsolidierungsverfahren und der Einrichtung zwischen Unternehmen

## Arbeiten mit anderen

- Verwaltung der Beziehung zu externen Auditoren und Beratern auf gewöhnlichen Anfragen unter Aufsicht des Leiters der Konsolidierung
- Handeln Sie als Bezugspunkt für lokale Finanzteams und andere Gruppenfunktionen in Konsolidierungs- und Berichtsangelegenheiten

## Requisiti e competenze

## Ihre Expertise:

- Master-Abschluss in Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
- Mindestens drei Jahre in technischer Rechnungslegung und Finanzberichterstattung, mit fundierten Kenntnissen der IFRS, erworben in einer großen multinationalen Gruppe oder in einer Prüfungs- oder Beratungsfirma
- Tiefes Wissen über Konsolidierungsregeln und -techniken
- Englisch auf professionellem Niveau, geschrieben und gesprochen
- Praktische fließende KI-Tools wie Claude, die neben der Expertise der IFRS stehen. Kandidaten müssen bereits KI einsetzen, um die Berichterstattung und Analyse in der realen Welt zu beschleunigen, während sie über das kritische Urteil verfügen, das erforderlich ist, um zu wissen, wann sie KI-Ausgaben vertrauen und wann sie auf Genauigkeit überprüft werden müssen.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel: Lookups, Pivot-Tabellen und Vertrauen arbeiten mit großen Datenmengen. Solide Kenntnisse des Google Workspace, insbesondere G-Sheets

## Wünschenswert:

- Audit-Erfahrung in einem Big 4-Unternehmen gewonnen
- Kenntnisse von Tagetik oder eines vergleichbaren Konsolidierungs- und Berichtssystems

## Cosa offriamo

Vorteile der Zusammenarbeit mit uns:

## Wie wir zusammenarbeiten:

- Ein inklusives, freundliches und internationales Umfeld (Sie arbeiten mit Kollegen aus +10 Ländern und über 48 Nationalitäten zusammen)

- Kürzere Arbeitswoche (36h als Vollzeit), mit einem halben Arbeitstag freitags

- Flexibler Beginn und Ende des Arbeitstages

- Möglichkeit, von überall aus für einen Zeitraum pro Jahr zu arbeiten, der nach lokalen Vorschriften definiert ist

## Wie wir gemeinsam lernen:

- Fri-Yays: einen halben Tag am Freitagmorgen mit einem No-Meeting-Mandat und gewidmet tiefer Arbeit, persönliches Wachstum, Lernen und Training und / oder Fokuszeit.

- Schulungspfade zur Entwicklung von Fach- und Führungskompetenzen, Zugang zu E-Learning-Plattformen wie O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (je nach Abteilung) und zu unserer internen Plattform mit maßgeschneiderten Schulungsinhalten

## Weitere Vergünstigungen: - 2 bezahlte freie Tage pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Zwecke - Gelegentliche soziale Veranstaltungen zur Förderung von Verbindungen zwischen Kollegen - Reisevergnügungen und exklusive Mitarbeitertarife - Wir unterstützen unsere Mitarbeiter durch die wichtigsten Momente des Lebens mit Urlaubsoptionen (z. B. elterliche Pflichten, Ehen, Trauer, Umzüge usw.) im Einklang mit den lokalen Gesetzen. Wünschst du, du wärst hier? Das tun wir auch! Auswahlverfahrensschritte*:

- HR-Interview

- 1. Interview (Manager): Soft Skills + technisches Wissen

- Abschlusstreffen persönlich (Chiasso)

- Angebot verlängert

(*Bitte beachten Sie, dass der Prozess leicht variieren kann.) Der verantwortliche Recruiter teilt mehr Details mit, wenn er das Interview erstellt

## Unser Engagement, Vielfalt zu feiern und Zugehörigkeit zu generieren

Im herzen unserer kultur steht die verpflichtung zur inklusion über rasse, geschlecht, alter, sexuelle orientierung, religion, geschlechtsidentität oder ausdruck und zugänglichkeit. Wir glauben fest an einen Chancengleichheitsraum, der einladend ist und die Einzigartigkeit aller, die hier arbeiten, feiert. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche gelebte Erfahrungen und respektieren Standpunkte, da wir wissen, dass Unicity Innovationen vorantreibt. Wir möchten sicherstellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter die Gemeinschaften auf der ganzen Welt widerspiegeln, denen wir beim Reisen helfen.

Förderkriterien:

Mit der Übermittlung Ihrer Informationen und Ihres Antrags bestätigen Sie, dass Sie rechtlich befugt sind, im Beschäftigungsland zu arbeiten, und dass Sie keine Visa-Sponsoring benötigen, um den Status eines Arbeitsvisums zu erhalten.

Auf lastminute.com leben wir für die Feiertage. Wir sind der europäische Reisetechnologieführer im Bereich Dynamische Urlaubspakete. Mit Technologie verwandeln wir spontane Gedanken in sinnvolle Erfahrungen und helfen Menschen, die Welt zu bereisen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'équipe de consolidation est délibérément petite. Il n'y a pas de couche entre vous et la sortie: vous posséderez les flux de travail fin à fin, rapporter directement au Chef de Consolidation, et voir votre travail terre dans les numéros que le Groupe publie.

Il vous place également au centre de l'organisation financière. La consolidation se situe au point où chaque équipe financière locale, le Groupe fonctionne et les auditeurs externes convergent, de sorte que vous allez construire une vue de la façon dont l'ensemble de l'entreprise fonctionne que peu d'autres rôles offrent. Si vous voulez que les IFRS techniques fonctionnent avec visibilité, c'est le siège.

## Le travail en bref :

- Spécialiste de la consolidation
- Modèle de travail : Hybride de Chiasso ou à part entière de Roumanie
- Équipe : Équipe de consolidation au sein du ministère des Finances.
- . Vous soutiendrez également l'équipe sur le travail qui sert d'autres ministères dans l'ensemble du Groupe. ## Ce que vous aurez besoin de résoudre : Préparer, tenir et exécuter le rapprochement des comptes consolidés du grand livre et des états financiers : bilan consolidé mensuel, profits et pertes, états des flux de trésorerie et des capitaux propres, calendrier des dépenses en capital, calendriers interentreprises et produits livrables connexes
- Préparation et exécution des ajustements de consolidation et des calculs interentreprises selon les politiques du Groupe en matière de prix de transfert
- Rapprochement de la situation financière nette du Groupe sur une base mensuelle et comptabilisation des principaux plans d'incitation à long terme du personnel
- Exécuter des examens périodiques des paquets de rapports préparés par les gestionnaires locaux des finances à Tagetik
- Appuyer la préparation du test d'insuffisance (IAS 36) et des divulgations provisoires et annuelles
- Appuyer l'élaboration de chiffres prévisionnels et de modèles financiers sur demande tant au niveau du Groupe qu'au niveau local.

## Systèmes, processus et contrôle:

- Élaborer, tester, déployer et tenir à jour des rapports consolidés à Tagetik
- Concevoir et maintenir des contrôles internes sur les processus d'information financière, en veillant à ce que les activités de contrôle dans votre domaine de responsabilité soient entièrement exécutées, documentées et formalisées
- Élaborer et tenir à jour des procédures documentées qui permettent de maintenir des systèmes, des processus et des contrôles efficaces et d'assurer l'exactitude des rapports financiers, y compris des lignes directrices pour la déclaration des filiales du Groupe et la tenue du plan comptable du Groupe
- Soutenir la mise en œuvre et la mise en place de procédures de consolidation et de la mise en place interentreprises

## Travailler avec d'autres

- Gérer les relations avec les auditeurs externes et les consultants sur les demandes ordinaires sous la supervision du chef de la consolidation
- Agir comme point de référence pour les équipes financières locales et autres fonctions du Groupe sur les questions de consolidation et d ' établissement de rapports

## Requisiti e concurrente

## Votre expertise :

- Maîtrise en comptabilité ou finance
- Au moins trois ans en comptabilité technique et en information financière, avec une connaissance approfondie des IFRS, acquis dans un grand groupe multinational ou dans une société d'audit ou de conseil
- Connaissance approfondie des règles et techniques de consolidation

## What you will own

## The data model of your business area. Entities, granularity, dimensional models, metrics and definitions. You decide what the source of truth is and where the boundaries of the business area sit. Definitions are treated as a product here: one owner, one documented definition, one place where it is computed, the same value wherever it is consumed.

## The relationship with [STAKEHOLDERS]. You co-own the KPI set the business steers by: what we look at every week, how it is defined, and when it needs to change. You are expected to reframe the question when the question is the problem. On smaller or ongoing work, you agree priorities directly with your stakeholders. On the wider roadmap, you set priorities together with your manager, including what we can postpone or deprioritise.

## Analysis, sized to the business area. The split between analysis and development depends on the business area you look after, and it can change over time.

## Trust in the numbers. You build validation rules and monitoring on your own models, so that data issues are caught before the data reaches a dashboard or a stakeholder. When something goes wrong, you handle it end to end: find the cause, explain the business impact, fix it and add a test so it does not happen again.

## Leverage beyond yourself. What you learn about your business area becomes reusable for the whole department — documented models, shared glossaries and AI context, automations

## Requisiti e competenze

## What we look for

## Essential

- ## Solid, hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a similar data role. We look at what you have built, not at the number of years.
- ## Real depth in dimensional modelling: grain, keys, slowly changing dimensions, and the judgement to know when a model is semantically wrong even though it runs.
- ## Advanced SQL and query optimisation on a cloud or MPP warehouse. We run both BigQuery and Vertica — you need to be strong on one of them, not both.
- ## Hands-on dbt experience for transformation and modelling, and comfort with orchestration (Airflow, Cloud Composer or equivalent).
- ## Working knowledge of a business area ([BUSINESS SOURCES AND CONCEPTS]) and the ability to connect data work to business outcomes rather than to task completion.
- ## A track record of working directly with non-technical stakeholders: turning a business question into a data requirement, presenting findings, and disagreeing with the brief when the data says otherwise.
- ## Fluent English, written and spoken.

## Strong plus

- ## AI-assisted ways of working (see below) — daily use of an agentic assistant for development and analysis, and the ability to write the context that makes it reliable. If you already work this way, you will be quick here and we will want you shaping how the rest of the department does it.
- ## Python for automation and lightweight services.
- ## Data contracts, testing frameworks, or data observability tooling.
- ## Experience as the reference data person embedded in a business team.
- ## Semantic or metric layers consumed by BI tools and by AI agents.
- ## Travel, OTA, marketplace or another high-volume transactional business.

## How we work with AI

## Claude is part of the standard toolkit of this department, connected to our own systems, and it changes what we consider skilled work. Writing correct SQL is no longer the scarce part. Deciding what correct means, and building the context that lets both people and agents get it right, is.

## In practice that means: agentic development as the default for SQL, dbt, Python and documentation, with normal engineering discipline around it; context written and maintained by you — instruction files, reusable skills, business glossaries, model documentation — because the quality of the output depends on it; agent-assisted data quality work with a human review gate wherever it feeds a business decision; and clear-eyed judgement about where these tools are unreliable in this specific business area.

## We are not looking for prompt-writing as a job. We are looking for someone whose modelling and business judgement is worth multiplying.

## Cosa offriamo

## Life of working in lastminute.com

## Perks of working with us:

## - An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities)

## - Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays [Note: delete reference for open roles in FR and India] - Flexible start and end of the working day [you can add: “with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm”] - Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together:

## - Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time.

## - Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content

## Other perks: - 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes

## - Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues

## - Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares

## - We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws.

## Selection process steps*:

- ## HR interview (10-30 minutes)
- ## 1st interview (Manager): soft skills + technical knowledge
- ## Test step online (technical evaluation, AI usage included)
- ## 2nd interview (Manager + team member): Test review
- ## Only for senior roles: final meeting (30 mins) with the Director
- ## Offer extended

## (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview)

## Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

## At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

## Eligibility criteria:

## By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.

## Chi è lastminute.com

lastminute.com is the European Travel Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. It operates a portfolio of well-known brands such as lastminute.com, Volagratis, Rumbo, weg.de, Bravofly, Jetcost and Hotelscan.

Our mission is to lead the travel industry by leveraging technology to simplify, personalise, and enhance our customers’ travel experience. Experts in brightening up online travel, we help our customers find and do "whatever makes them pink".

We continuously invest in talented people who ensure our offering is closer to the needs of the customers and keep us at the cutting edge of technology evolution. More than 1,700 employees spread across our offices worldwide develop our own products and services to power the entire traveller journey for millions of people.

## Quello che possiedi

## Il modello di dati della tua area aziendale. Entità, granularità, modelli dimensionali, metriche e definizioni. Decidi tu quale sia la fonte della verità e dove siedono i confini della zona commerciale. Le definizioni sono trattate come un prodotto qui: un proprietario, una definizione documentata, un luogo dove viene calcolato, lo stesso valore dovunque esso venga consumato.

## Il rapporto con [STAKEHOLDERS]. Voi co-diate il KPI impostate gli imprenditori da: quello che guardiamo ogni settimana, come è definito, e quando ha bisogno di cambiare. Si prevede di ridefinire la domanda quando la domanda è il problema. Sul lavoro più piccolo o continuo, accetti le priorità direttamente con i tuoi stakeholder. Sulla più ampia tabella di marcia, hai impostato le priorità insieme al tuo manager, tra cui quello che possiamo rinviare o deprioritizzare.

## Analisi, dimensionata nell'area aziendale. La divisione tra analisi e sviluppo dipende dall'area di business che si prende cura, e può cambiare nel tempo.

## Fidatevi dei numeri. Si costruisce regole di validazione e monitoraggio sui propri modelli, in modo che i problemi di dati vengano catturati prima che i dati raggiungano una dashboard o uno stakeholder. Quando qualcosa va storto, si gestisce fino alla fine: trovare la causa, spiegare l'impatto aziendale, risolvere e aggiungere un test in modo che non accada di nuovo.

## Leva oltre te stesso. Ciò che si impara sul vostro business area diventa riutilizzabile per tutto il dipartimento — modelli documentati, glossari condivisi e contesto AI, automazione

## Requisiti e competenze

## Cosa cerchiamo

## Essenziale

- ## Solid, hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering o un ruolo di dati simile. Guardiamo quello che avete costruito, non al numero di anni.
- ## Profondità reale nella modellazione dimensionale: grano, chiavi, dimensioni che cambiano lentamente, e il giudizio di sapere quando un modello è semanticamente sbagliato anche se funziona.
- ## Advanced SQL e ottimizzazione delle query su un cloud o un magazzino MPP. Gestiamo sia BigQuery che Vertica — è necessario essere forti su uno di loro, non entrambi.
- ## Hands-on dbt experience per la trasformazione e la modellazione, e comfort con orchestrazione (Airflow, Cloud Composer o equivalente).
- ## Conoscenza di lavoro di un'area aziendale ([BUSINESS SOURCES AND CONCEPTS]) e la capacitÃ di collegare il lavoro dei dati ai risultati aziendali piuttosto che al completamento del compito.
- ## Un track record di lavorare direttamente con gli stakeholder non tecnici: trasformare una domanda di business in un requisito di dati, presentando i risultati e in disaccordo con il breve quando i dati dicono diversamente.
- ## Fluente inglese, scritto e parlato.

## Più forte

- ## AI-assisted way of working (vedi sotto) — uso quotidiano di un assistente agente per lo sviluppo e l'analisi, e la capacità di scrivere il contesto che lo rende affidabile. Se si lavora già in questo modo, sarete veloci qui e vogliamo che si modella come il resto del dipartimento lo fa.
- ## Python per l'automazione e servizi leggeri.
- ## Contratti di dati, framework di prova, o strumenti di osservazione dei dati.
- ## Esperienza come persona dei dati di riferimento incorporata in un team aziendale.
- ## Strati semantici o metrici consumati dagli strumenti BI e dagli agenti AI.
- ## Viaggi, OTA, marketplace o un altro business transazionale ad alto volume.

## Come lavoriamo con AI

## Claude fa parte del toolkit standard di questo reparto, collegato ai nostri sistemi, e cambia ciò che consideriamo lavoro qualificato. Scrivere SQL corretto non è più la parte più scarsa. Decidere quali mezzi corretti, e la costruzione del contesto che permette sia le persone che gli agenti ottenere giusto, è.

## In pratica questo significa: lo sviluppo agentec come il default per SQL, dbt, Python e la documentazione, con la normale disciplina ingegneristica intorno a esso; contesto scritto e mantenuto da voi — i file di istruzioni, le abilità riutilizzabili, i glossari aziendali, la documentazione del modello — perché la qualità dell'output dipende da esso; agente-assisted data quality work con un cancello di revisione umano ovunque alimenta una decisione aziendale; e chiaro-eyed giudizio su dove questi strumenti sono inaffidabili in questo settore aziendale.

- ## Act as the subject-matter expert on channel manager and switch connectivity: ARI distribution (availability, rates, inventory), booking delivery, content and mapping, and rate/availability push and pull.

- ## Read and interpret partner API documentation and integration specifications to assess fit against our needs.
- ## Identify technical gaps and limitations in current connections that affect content quality, availability, competitiveness, conversion or operational efficiency.
- ## Diagnose recurring connectivity issues and pinpoint root cause on the partner or protocol side.
- ## Translate technical findings into simple, credible business cases to justify upgrading, replacing or onboarding channel managers and switches, quantifying expected impact coverage, competitiveness, error reduction, operational savings — with data and analytics colleagues.
- ## Support commercial and partnership conversations that require technical depth.
- ## Partner with Product and Engineering during discovery and integration work, coordinating between external partners and internal teams across Europe and Asia.

## Requisiti e competenze

## - 4+ years working hands-on with hotel connectivity (channel managers, switches, connectivity/aggregation platforms) on the OTA, bedbank, channel manager or hotel-tech side.

## - Deep practical understanding of ARI flows, booking delivery, content mapping and connectivity protocols (XML/JSON, push/pull).

## - AI knoweldge

## - Comfortable in technical conversations with connectivity partners: reading API documentation, understanding integration constraints and diagnosing connectivity issues, without needing to be a software engineer.

## - Detailed familiarity with the channel manager and switch landscape and its key players.

## - Basic SQL and data literacy to support impact analysis.

## - Exposure to GDS, OTA integrations or property management systems.

## - Additional European languages.

## By joining our company, you will have the chance to:

## - Join a dynamic team in an inclusive-international environment

## - Grow thanks to the career journey and our internal mobility perspective

## - Manage your own schedule thanks to the flexible start and end of the working day

## - Work a shorter working week (36h), of which 4 hours on Friday morning

## - Get focus time for learning, development and deep work on Friday mornings

## - Work partially or fully remote according to local laws

## - Enjoy continuous training thanks to our company platform

## - Benefit from employee discounts on travel

## - Receive 2 days off per year for the purpose of volunteering

## - Receive a voucher after some years in the company

## - Get free snacks / fruit / hot drinks / water / beverages at our offices

## - Welfare platform (Corporate Benefits) where you will find dedicated discounts with more than 1500 partners

## Perks of working with us : How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together : Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Selection process steps* : HR interview (15-30 minutes) Manager + Team Interview (45 minutes) Offline Business Case Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview) Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. Importante: si tratta di una piattaforma tecnica e di un ruolo di prodotto orientato alla fornitura. I prodotti che possiedi sono API, connettività, extranet e strumenti operativi interni che servono i nostri marchi B2C e supportano iniziative strategiche B2B. ## - Definire metriche di successo e KPI per ogni iniziativa di prodotto.

- Collabora efficacemente tra le squadre distribuite in Europa e Asia.

## Requisiti e competenze

## Competenze ed Esperienza

## - 3+ anni in Product Management, o un ruolo tecnico o analista equivalente che passa al prodotto, idealmente con esposizione a B2B, piattaforma o prodotti di integrazione.

## - Acume tecnico autentico: confortevole con API, flussi di dati e integrazioni di sistema, e in grado di tenere discussioni tecniche credibili con gli ingegneri.

JOB DESCRIPTION

## We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about designing & building AI solutions, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job. The job in brief: Job Title - AI Automation Engineer Working model - hybrid from Switzerland Team - you will join the Automation Engineering team within the Automation department. Level - Professional Location - Chiasso, Switzerland (only for hybrid positions) Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week) What your impact will be: Build and scale n8n automation workflows. Design, build, and maintain production-grade workflows on our self-hosted n8n Enterprise platform (AWS EKS), supporting business units across the company and helping grow our Citizen Developer / self-service automation program. Design and build custom AI solutions. Develop applications and tools that use AI to support key business processes. These solutions will be tailored to specific needs across different departments. Connect AI tools with our systems. Integrate external AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude) with our existing tools using APIs, low-code platforms like n8n, and custom connectors. Contribute to our governed knowledge layer. Support and extend our Company Context / Universal RAG Knowledge Base, including document ingestion pipelines, retrieval quality, and access governance. Work with natural language processing (NLP). Create tools for analyzing conversations, automating emails, and generating insights from customer interactions. Build generative AI solutions. Use generative AI to automate tasks like content creation and communication personalization. Maintain and improve systems. Update code, monitor system performance, and retrain models regularly to ensure everything runs smoothly. Collaborate with tech teams. Work closely with data engineers, DevOps, and other developers to make sure AI tools are scalable and reliable. What You Might Build: n8n workflows automating cross-department processes NLP-based systems that analyze calls and emails RAG-powered assistants and chatbots grounded in our Company Context knowledge base Virtual assistants and chatbots to support internal teams Recommendation engines that guide real-time sales or support actions Automated tools to generate personalized content Dashboards and reporting tools that surface AI-generated insights Your expertise: 3+ years of hands-on AI development: You’ve built and shipped AI solutions that led to real business impact—whether that’s increased revenue, reduced cost, or improved customer satisfaction (NPS). Fast, practical builder: You move quickly from idea to working prototype, and improve as you go. You aim for results, not perfection. End-to-end problem solver: You take ownership from idea to deployment—writing documentation only when needed, and focusing on what works. Strong technical troubleshooting: You can quickly find the cause of technical issues using logs, dev tools, or pattern matching. Security-aware mindset: You understand authentication, authorization scopes, and safe handling of credentials. Communicator and storyteller: You present your ideas clearly, show live demos with confidence, and help business teams understand the value of your work. Your Skills and Tools Automation Platforms: Hands-on experience with n8n (or similar low-code platforms such as Make, Zapier), including self-hosted/enterprise deployments. Languages: Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. AI/ML Development: Experience with LLMs (e.g. Claude, Gemini, OpenAI), prompt engineering, and building agentic workflows; familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and document ingestion pipelines. Data & APIs: Strong understanding of APIs, cloud-based infrastructure, and microservices architecture. Software Practices: Familiar with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and the full software development lifecycle. Cloud & Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), container tools (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures. Selection process steps*: - HR interview (10-30 minutes) - 1st interview (Manager): soft skills + technical knowledge - Business/Technical Case - Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview) Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

Eligibility criteria:

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.
